_doc: Low horizontal slash on the RIGHT side: starts on the arm's RIGHT, ends on its LEFT. Frozen 2026-09-12 from the mirror of ATTACK_LOW_LR (captured.start/end = that mirrored windup/end in real degrees), then the end wrist lowered 12 deg so the blade points down instead of level. Note: a mirror_of move ignores its own captured entry, hence the standalone form. Delete captured.* to recompute from end/start.

_help.end.x: hand distance forward at the end of the slash (m, keep <= 0.27)
_help.end.z: height of the low line (m above the base plane)
_help.end.pan: where the slash ends (deg; negative = own left)
_help.start.dx: windup hand offset from the end, forward (m; negative = pulled back)
_help.start.dz: windup hand offset from the end, up (m)
_help.start.pan: where the slash starts (deg; + = own right)
_help.roll: wrist roll: -90 = jaw swings sideways on this side (keep -90)
_help.jaw_open: how wide the sword cocks before the sweep (0..100): smaller = comes from less wide
_help.t_windup: seconds: rest -> cocked low on the start side (0.85 = the old mirror timing)
_help.captured.start: windup pose (real degrees): the mirrored windup from ATTACK_LOW_LR, kept so only the end changes. Delete to recompute from start.*
_help.captured.end: end pose (real degrees): the mirrored end with wrist_flex +12 deg (blade tip lowered ~12 deg, pitch -3 -> -15). Delete to recompute from end.*

retired_2026-09-12.note: standalone version with captured poses, replaced by mirroring ATTACK_LOW_LR's arm shape
